info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API allows businesses to access a comprehensive list of loyalty partners associated with their program. This endpoint supports loyalty program managers and developers by providing detailed information about each partner to enhance customer engagement and loyalty strategies. Typical consumers include marketing teams and integration developers looking to leverage partner data for promotions and rewards. The API streamlines the retrieval process, ensuring timely access to relevant partnership information, which is crucial for maximizing customer loyalty initiatives.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of loyalty partners available in the system. It provides detailed information about each partner, including their offerings and benefits, enabling users to make informed decisions.
